description: Fictional sample brand for demonstrating BrandGate. Do not treat these as real company facts.

rules.title: Friendly and clear brand voice
rules.rule_text: Use friendly, clear and professional language. Avoid exaggerated, absolute or sensational promises.

rules.title: Use the approved product name
rules.rule_text: Refer to the main product as Northstar Workspace. Do not use Dashboard as a substitute product name.

rules.title: Avoid unsupported guaranteed outcomes
rules.rule_text: Do not promise guaranteed sales, revenue, productivity or business outcomes unless the exact claim has current approved evidence.

rules.title: Describe benefits without overstating certainty
rules.rule_text: Describe product capabilities accurately. Prefer qualified language such as 'designed to help' when a measurable result is not guaranteed by approved evidence.

rules.title: Maintain readable text contrast
rules.rule_text: For ordinary text, target at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against its actual background, subject to applicable WCAG exceptions.

rules.title: Use approved brand assets
rules.rule_text: Use only approved logo and brand assets. Do not recolour or distort the supplied logo.
